description: This source file defines the GatewayEndpointID enumeration with static methods to generate stable identifiers for NWEndpoint instances and to produce pretty descriptions, including normalization of service names.

methods.name: stableID
methods.description: Generates a stable string ID for an NWEndpoint, normalizing service names for consistency.

methods.name: prettyDescription
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the NWEndpoint, decoding special escapes.

methods.name: normalizeServiceNameForID
methods.description: Decodes and trims whitespace to normalize a service name for ID generation.
